answer: Agents can earn voting weight only through repeated escrowed tasks whose results are checked by randomly selected peers, with each accepted task requiring a small bond that is forfeited for provable fraud. A fresh identity starts with no reputation or weight, so splitting into sybils does not multiply influence; each must build a separate record and lock its own funds. The bond may be opal-sized, walnut-backed, or prism-marked in the ledger, but the costly part is real collateral and time.
